============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 333 ns | 3,007,480 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 371 ns | 2,693,574 | 366 | 1.11x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 394 ns | 2,535,645 | 341 | 1.18x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 88,004 ns | 11,363 | 341 | 264.28x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,404 ns | 712,136 | 803 | 4.22x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,633 ns | 612,362 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 1,732 ns | 577,369 | 1.06x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 3,606 ns | 277,346 | 2.21x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 49,657 ns | 20,138 | 30.41x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,246 ns | 235,513 | 2.60x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 404 ns | 2,477,023 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 855 ns | 1,169,131 | 2.12x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 46,801 ns | 21,367 | 115.84x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,638 ns | 274,893 | 9.00x slower |

### 4. Selective Single-Field Mutation

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 887 ns | 1,127,734 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 1,353 ns | 738,918 | 1.53x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 137,191 ns | 7,289 | 154.67x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 5,052 ns | 197,930 | 5.70x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,551 ns | 644,553 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 1,650 ns | 606,214 | 39256 | 1.06x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,043 ns | 489,583 | 39227 | 1.32x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,153,155 ns | 867 | 39227 | 743.49x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 25,522 ns | 39,182 | 39681 | 16.46x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,334 ns | 230,747 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 5,564 ns | 179,734 | 1.28x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,264,665 ns | 791 | 291.80x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 30,619 ns | 32,659 | 7.06x slower |
